text:
Type: chevron runner rug
Use: covering a walkway; hallway, entryway, bedroom, kitchen
Style: contemporary, minimalist, modern
Materials: plush pile with carved high-low texture
Colors: medium cool grey, charcoal grey
Shape: long narrow rectangle, tone-on-tone carved zigzag chevron pattern, plain edges, soft dense pile, light visual weight
Feel: calm, soft, understated
Goes with: mid or dark wood floors, white walls, wicker baskets; minimalist, modern or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Chevron Runner Hallway Rug, 7' 6" x 2' 3", Grey
product.description: This modern rug brings sophistication to any room with its graceful interlocked chevron pattern. Low- and high-pile loops are combined to create a three-dimensional look and feel. The durable fabric is ready for high-traffic areas. 7' 6" x 2' 3" High-low medium pile is easy to clean Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
